items.title: Tata Motors Q4 profit falls 32% to ₹5,783 crore on weak JLR performance
items.description: In the March quarter, Tata Motors reported a significant 32 percent drop in net profit, reflecting increased operational costs and obstacles at Jaguar Land Rover. On a brighter note, the domestic market delivered impressive growth, with passenger vehicle sales up nearly 50 percent.

items.title: ITC Hotels Q4 results: Profit rises 23% YoY to Rs 317 crore; co declares Re 1/share dividend
items.description: ITC Hotels announced robust fourth-quarter earnings for FY26. Profit after tax surged 23% year-on-year. Revenue from operations also saw a significant 14% increase. The company's hospitality business demonstrated continued growth. For the full fiscal year, profit after tax rose 29%. A final dividend of Rs 1 per equity share has been recommended.

items.title: Hindustan Copper Q4 Results: Cons PAT surges 135% YoY to Rs 444 crore, revenue jumps 58%
items.description: Hindustan Copper Q4 Results: Hindustan Copper reported a significant 134% surge in consolidated net profit to Rs 444 crore for the March-ended quarter, driven by a 58% revenue increase to Rs 1,156 crore. The company also recommended a dividend of Rs 1.86 per share for FY26. Full-year PAT grew 97% to Rs 921 crore.
